heard: Asteroid Phaeton orbits closer to the Sun than Mercury. Its barren, rocky surface bakes up to 750 degrees Celsius. That intense, extreme heat physically cracks the rock apart. Scientists long thought solar dust created the annual geminids. Then NASA observatories revealed the tail is actually sodium gas. Since gas cannot form meteors, the true origin remains a complete mystery. This amazing, baking rock is what created the geminids.
